headline: NSE waives fines for HMA Agro non-compliance
summary: HMA Agro Industries received a waiver of fines from NSE for non-compliance with audit and stakeholder committee composition rules for Q1 FY27.

headline: EAAA India Alternatives files RHP for ₹12,000 crore IPO
summary: Edelweiss subsidiary EAAA India Alternatives filed its Red Herring Prospectus for a ₹12,000 crore IPO. The offer for sale opens on October 26, 2026.

headline: IOB gets SEBI nod for 10 crore employee shares
summary: Indian Overseas Bank received SEBI approval to issue 10 crore fresh equity shares to employees via ESPS. This move aims to comply with Minimum Public Shareholding norms.

headline: Avalon Tech forms Zollner JV for EMS expansion
summary: Avalon Technologies incorporates Zollner Avalon Private Limited. Zollner to acquire 51% stake in the new electronic manufacturing services subsidiary.

headline: Hindustan Zinc Q2FY27: Net profit jumps 142% YoY
summary: Hindustan Zinc, a Vedanta subsidiary, reported a 142% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹6,412 crore. Revenue surged 76% to ₹14,582 crore, driven by higher zinc and silver prices.

headline: EPL sets Oct 26 record date for ₹60 crore CP maturity
summary: EPL Limited has fixed October 26, 2026 as the record date for the maturity of commercial papers worth ₹60 crore. The instruments are due to mature on October 27, 2026.

headline: String Metaverse appoints Dr. Ravi as Director Emeritus
summary: String Metaverse Limited has appointed Dr. Sethurathnam Ravi as Director Emeritus in an honorary capacity effective October 20, 2026, bringing 37 years of board experience.

headline: Shri Niwas Leasing Q2FY27: Net profit surges to ₹15,316
summary: Shri Niwas Leasing & Finance reported a massive jump in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹15,316.35 from ₹16.33 in the previous quarter. Revenue from operations also rose significantly.

headline: Venus Pipes starts spooling ops; gets ₹185 cr LOI
summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes commenced pipe spooling operations ahead of schedule and received a ₹185 crore Letter of Intent from a data centre customer, aiming for faster execution.

headline: Shardul Securities Q2FY27 Results
summary: Shardul Securities Ltd reported a net loss of ₹32.34 lakh in Q2FY27 due to fair value changes. Consolidated PAT stood at ₹10.98 crore for H1FY27.

headline: Evervie Health signs LOI for 10 LINAC systems
summary: Evervie Health Limited signed a Letter of Intent with Elekta Solutions AB for ten HARMONY LINAC systems. Deal value estimated at $11-15 million, payable in SEK.

headline: Dhruva Capital approves ₹160 crore QIP
summary: Dhruva Capital Services board approved raising up to ₹160 crore via Qualified Institutional Placement in one or more tranches, following shareholder approval.

headline: Pioneer Agro posts Q2FY27 loss of ₹25.09 lakh
summary: Pioneer Agro Extracts reported a net loss of ₹25.09 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹4.12 lakh in the year-ago period, as zero operational revenue persisted.

headline: Quality Power starts coil factory in Sangli
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments commenced manufacturing at its new Global Coil Factory in Sangli on October 20, 2026. The facility targets high-voltage reactors.

headline: Grauer & Weil signs MoU for solar JV
summary: Grauer & Weil (India) Ltd enters into a Memorandum of Understanding with RENA Technologies GmbH to form a Joint Venture for the Solar Manufacturing value chain.

headline: Millworks Technologies appoints Sudhir Bellare Rai as VP
summary: Millworks Technologies appointed Sudhir Bellare Rai as VP for Sheet Metal Fabrication and named S. Janardhan & Associates as internal auditor for FY27.

headline: Viyash Scientific appoints new SVP HR, accepts retirement
summary: Viyash Scientific Limited appointed Dr. Mallikharjuna Rao Nagineni as SVP HR effective October 20, 2026. Mr. Prasad Lad retired from the role on the same date.
